data.exact_reserve_text: Adjustments to the amounts of claims provisions established in prior years are reflected in the financial statements for the period in which the adjustments are made.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Reinsurance-to-close (RITC) accepted into the syndicate increased gross claims outstanding for prior years when the SPA was novated into the syndicate.

data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding rose materially from GBP 71.068m at 1 January 2020 to GBP 114.556m at 31 December 2020. The increase reflects a combination of factors including the addition of reinsurance-to-close (RITC) from Syndicate/SPA 6126 and adverse movements in claims development, with COVID-19 and IBNR recalibration noted as considerations. The presence of RITC materially distorts development metrics, making isolation of a gross prior-year only movement from the published tables unreliable.
raw_causal_phrases: Adjustments to the amounts of claims provisions established in prior years are reflected in the financial statements for the period in which the adjustments are made.
consideration of the potential impact of COVID assumptions
data.data_quality_notes: No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision' line was published. A large RITC (reinsurance-to-close) from SPA/Syndicate 6126 is present in the technical provisions (gross RITC amounts shown for 2019 and 2020), which materially distorts claims development tables and renders triangle-based PYD calculations unreliable. Therefore no gross prior-year-only movement could be confidently extracted. If only net figures were available they were not used; the report does explicitly quantify RITC gross amounts (used in prior_year_events).
